svg.text: • search(city, artist, venueId, from, to, pageable)
• forces status = PUBLISHED — only sellable events are searchable
1. Only PUBLISHED events are exposed via search
2. city — exact match on event venue city (case-insensitive)
4. venue — filtered by venue id (venue_id FK)
7. Results cached under eventSearch::<key> (Redis · TTL 10 min)
8. All filters optional · combined with AND · NULL = no filter
